name: site-shell
title: Site shell
description: Proves Wave 5's pieces work together on one page for a fictional homestay, Casa Aldona: a header with Tabs (Overview, Rooms, Book) and a Menu (Account), a Dialog ("Ask the house"), a Drawer (the rooms), a scroll section driving the Paus scene by real scroll, and a Kantar interlude between two steps of a small booking flow. Every piece is a plain library part; this recipe adds no new theatre of its own, only the composition and a tiny two-step flow state (site-shell.core.js). Without JavaScript every section shows and Dialog/Drawer's openers are real links to a real page.
